reviewNotes: ADMIT-BACKSTAGE. Current SMARTY first-party material establishes an active rolling-monthly voice product from GBP6, new-customer eSIM ordering, no credit search, multiple payment methods, a 220-day inactive-account termination rule, and mainland-China roaming with free incoming SMS. Paused service retains incoming calls/texts, but paused-plus-roaming behavior is not explicitly guaranteed and 60 consecutive days abroad can trigger full-service suspension; third-party OTP delivery remains unguaranteed.

events.outcome: Current SMARTY material resolves the old monthly-payment-only assumption: a plan can remain inactive before automatic account closure at 220 days, while current China roaming explicitly lists free incoming SMS; active service must be renewed before relying on calls/text/data.

data.acquisitionSummary: SMARTY currently sells rolling-monthly voice plans with unlimited calls/texts from GBP6 for 5GB. New customers can choose eSIM during signup and receive activation material by email; physical SIM delivery is UK-only. SMARTY documents no credit search for monthly plan payment, but does not explicitly establish a passport-free/nonresident identity policy or guarantee overseas-first activation.

keep.action: Disable auto-renew to pause. SMARTY says it keeps the account open for six months and automatically closes an account if the plan remains inactive for 220 days, with a warning 40 days before closure. The current lowest rolling voice plan is GBP6; renewing service before the 220-day inactive deadline is the documented recovery/keep action. No annual cost is fabricated because SMARTY does not state an exact long-run renewal cadence beyond the inactive-account clock.

data.chinaActivation: Physical SIM delivery is UK-only, while new-customer eSIM ordering is digital and activation material is emailed. Overseas-first activation is not explicitly guaranteed, so China-first acquisition remains unverified.
data.kyc: SMARTY states no credit search is required. Signup requires customer details and payment; the reviewed pages do not explicitly state a no-ID/passport-free policy, so that claim is not made.
data.payment: SMARTY accepts credit/debit card, PayPoint cash, PayPal and Apple/Google Pay; Direct Debit/BACS are not used.
data.roamingSms: SMARTY's current mainland-China roaming page lists receiving texts from any number as FREE. Its paused-service help also says incoming calls and texts remain available when a plan is not renewed, but the combination of paused service plus overseas roaming is not explicitly guaranteed. SMARTY may suspend all services after 60 consecutive days abroad, with a two-week warning. Third-party OTP delivery remains unguaranteed.
data.tariffSummary: Current GBP6 rolling voice entry plan; account auto-closes after 220 days inactive; eSIM available; no credit search; China roaming lists free incoming SMS.
guideSteps: Choose a current rolling voice plan, not the separate GBP5 data-only plan, and select eSIM if desired.
If parking the number, disable auto-renew and renew before the 220-day inactive-account closure threshold.
For overseas SMS/OTP, configure roaming and avoid treating the 220-day parking window as permanent-roaming permission: SMARTY may suspend all services after 60 consecutive days abroad.
